instruction: Lift the long box with both arms, one hand at each end, keep it level, and hold it still at least 5 cm above the table.

outcome.real_measurement: Lifted: the box's lowest corner >= 5 cm above the table at every judged step. Real world: RGB-D / side camera.
Level: the box's long axis within 5 deg of horizontal at every judged step. Real world: pose estimate of the box.
Held by the LEFT arm: contact impulse between the box and the left robot > 0 in every judged step (substep-accumulated). Real world: wrist F/T or gripper current.
Held by the RIGHT arm: contact impulse between the box and the right robot > 0 in every judged step. Real world: as above.
Settled: the fastest bounding-box corner of every judged object moves <= 2 cm/s at every judged step, speed from positions (v3.2, E24c fix 1). Real world: frame differencing of the tracked pose.
Stays put: the box centre moves <= 2 mm over the judged window. Real world: tracked pose, 1 s.

counterexamples.name: expert
counterexamples.description: positive control: each arm grasps its end, both close, both TCPs rise 6-8 cm together, hold

counterexamples.name: single_arm_center
counterexamples.description: the left arm alone grasps the box at its centre and lifts it level; the right arm stays home

counterexamples.name: one_end_lift
counterexamples.description: the left arm alone grasps its end and lifts it 6-8 cm; the right arm stays home (the box either pivots, the other end staying on the table, or is held cantilevered by the one grasp)

counterexamples.name: low_lift
counterexamples.description: both arms grasp and lift only 2 cm

counterexamples.name: drop_at_end
counterexamples.description: both arms lift as the expert; the policy's last action opens both grippers (the box falls after the policy ends)

source.protocol: v3 (veritask, unchanged) + imsim v3.2 signals (imsim/imsim/verify/v32.py): position-based speeds, all-link enclosure, retreat aftermath, commanded vs actual opening, 5 s settle cap
source.released_code_predicate: box centre >= 5 cm above its reset height and long axis < 10 deg from horizontal at the evaluated step (RoboTwin lift_pot style; no check of who holds the box, of rest, or of what happens next)

notes: No release: the goal state is the box held by both arms. Settle (hold A) holds both arms where they stopped with their last gripper commands; quiescence uses position-based speeds (E24c: PhysX's reported velocity of a squeezed object is not zero while it does not move). The per-arm contact terms state 'with both arms'.
